name: OXYNOZCALM Nasal Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS

OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS contains Oxymetazoline which belongs to the group of medicines called Nasal decongestants. It is used in adults and in adolescents (aged 12 years or above) to provide relief from nasal congestion, itching and discomfort caused due to common cold, sinusitis (inflammation of the sinuses) or allergic rhinitis (an allergic condition).

Always use OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only. Do not use OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor.

Before using OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, hyperthyroidism, or any heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other problems in nasal tract apart from nasal congestion such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis).

Consult your doctor before using OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS Works

OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS opens and clears the nasal passages. It works by narrowing down the blood vessels supplying the nasal passage. This helps swollen blood vessels of the nasal tract to return to its normal size which allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. It also reduces the excessive nasal secretions and provides temporary relief from nasal inflammation, swelling and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS

Always use OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for intranasal use only.

For Nasal Drops: Gently instil few drops of this medicine into each nostril. Clean the dropper after application.

For Nasal Spray: Insert the spray nozzle inside the affected nostril. Press the pump to release the spray and sniff at the same time. Repeat the same to the other nostril if required. Clean the nozzle after application.

To avoid possible spread of infection, this pack should only be used by a single person. Do not use OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Discard the unused portion after 28 days of opening it.

OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Others

Have had a recent neurosurgery
Have narrow angle glaucoma (increased pressure within the eyes)
Have any problems in nasal tract such as chronic nasal inflammation with very dry nasal passages (rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis)
Have an enlarged prostate gland
Have phaeochromocytoma (a rare tumor of the adrenal glands)

Before using OXYNOZCALM NASAL DROPS, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes
Have hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid gland)

introduction:
Introduction About OTEK AC NEO EAR DROPS

OTEK AC NEO EAR DROPS is a combination of Benzocaine and Chloramphenicol which belongs to the group of medicines called Local Anesthetics and Antibiotics respectively. OTEK AC NEO EAR DROPS is used to manage bacterial infections of the external ear (otitis externa).

Otitis externa is a condition that causes inflammation (redness and swelling) of the external ear canal, which is the tube between the outer ear and eardrum. It is often called as swimmer's ear because repeated exposure to water can make the ear canal more vulnerable to inflammation. Your doctor may advise you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

OTEK AC NEO EAR DROPS is not recommended for use if you have burst in your ear drum. Before using OTEK AC NEO EAR DROPS inform your doctor if you have blood disorders (anemia) or bone marrow problems. There are limited information available on the use of OTEK AC NEO EAR DROPS during pregnancy and breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. The most common side effects of OTEK AC NEO EAR DROPS includes temporary itching, burning or irritation of the ear. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or persists for a longer duration.

It works against the growth of bacteria causing the infection.

name: OTRIGARD Ear Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About OTRIGARD EAR DROPS

OTRIGARD EAR DROPS is a combination of Clotrimazole and Lignocaine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals and Local anaesthetics respectively. It is used in the management of fungal ear infections. A fungal ear infection is an infection of the ear with a fungus that normally involves the external ear hole to the eardrum (the external auditory canal). hearing loss, a feeling of fullness in the ear, redness of the outer ear, itching, pain, swelling, ringing in the ears and white, yellow, grey, black or green discharge from the ear are the symptoms of fungal ear infection.

Clotrimazole is an antifungal medicine that manages the growth of fungi by changing the structure of their cell walls and provides relief from itching, congestion and swelling in the ears. To relieve ear pain, lignocaine is a local anaesthetic that alters signal conduction in nerves that transmit pain sensations. This collective action is useful in the effective management of middle ear fungal infections.

OTRIGARD EAR DROPS should be used with caution in pregnant women, women planning to become pregnant and breastfeeding women and only after consulting a doctor. OTRIGARD EAR DROPS is not recommended for use in patients allergic to clotrimazole, lidocaine or other local anaesthetics who have a blood disorder called acute porphyria. Although OTRIGARD EAR DROPS is appropriate for all age groups, it should be used with caution in children, adolescents and the elderly. The most common side effects of OTRIGARD EAR DROPS are irritation or a burning sensation in the ear. Consult your doctor if these symptoms become worse.

Introduction About OTOGESIC

Otogesic Ear Drops is a pain-relieving medicine used to provide relief from ear pain, swelling, irritation and discomfort. It contains dibucaine, 4-carboxymethylamino-4 aminodiphenyl sulphone, dihydroxy methyl carbamide as active ingredients.

Otogesic Ear Drops works by blocking the transfer of pain signals between the brain and spinal cord and the affected areas. This causes temporary numbness of the affected areas, thereby relieving pain, irritation and discomfort.

Introduction About OTOFUNGIN EAR DROPS

OTOFUNGIN EAR DROPS is a combination of Clotrimazole and Lignocaine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals and Local anaesthetics respectively. It is used in the management of fungal ear infections. A fungal ear infection is an infection of the ear with a fungus that normally involves the external ear hole to the eardrum (the external auditory canal). hearing loss, a feeling of fullness in the ear, redness of the outer ear, itching, pain, swelling, ringing in the ears and white, yellow, grey, black or green discharge from the ear are the symptoms of fungal ear infection.

Clotrimazole is an antifungal medicine that manages the growth of fungi by changing the structure of their cell walls and provides relief from itching, congestion and swelling in the ears. To relieve ear pain, lignocaine is a local anaesthetic that alters signal conduction in nerves that transmit pain sensations. This collective action is useful in the effective management of middle ear fungal infections.

OTOFUNGIN EAR DROPS should be used with caution in pregnant women, women planning to become pregnant and breastfeeding women and only after consulting a doctor. OTOFUNGIN EAR DROPS is not recommended for use in patients allergic to clotrimazole, lidocaine or other local anaesthetics who have a blood disorder called acute porphyria. Although OTOFUNGIN EAR DROPS is appropriate for all age groups, it should be used with caution in children, adolescents and the elderly. The most common side effects of OTOFUNGIN EAR DROPS are irritation or a burning sensation in the ear. Consult your doctor if these symptoms become worse.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOTRIN AC EAR DROPS

CLOTRIN AC EAR DROPS is a combination of Clotrimazole and Lignocaine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals and Local anaesthetics respectively. It is used in the management of fungal ear infections. A fungal ear infection is an infection of the ear with a fungus that normally involves the external ear hole to the eardrum (the external auditory canal). hearing loss, a feeling of fullness in the ear, redness of the outer ear, itching, pain, swelling, ringing in the ears and white, yellow, grey, black or green discharge from the ear are the symptoms of fungal ear infection.

Clotrimazole is an antifungal medicine that manages the growth of fungi by changing the structure of their cell walls and provides relief from itching, congestion and swelling in the ears. To relieve ear pain, lignocaine is a local anaesthetic that alters signal conduction in nerves that transmit pain sensations. This collective action is useful in the effective management of middle ear fungal infections.

CLOTRIN AC EAR DROPS should be used with caution in pregnant women, women planning to become pregnant and breastfeeding women and only after consulting a doctor. CLOTRIN AC EAR DROPS is not recommended for use in patients allergic to clotrimazole, lidocaine or other local anaesthetics who have a blood disorder called acute porphyria. Although CLOTRIN AC EAR DROPS is appropriate for all age groups, it should be used with caution in children, adolescents and the elderly. The most common side effects of CLOTRIN AC EAR DROPS are irritation or a burning sensation in the ear. Consult your doctor if these symptoms become worse.

Introduction About EARDRI EAR DROPS

Eardri Ear Drops helps to relieve the discomfort of water-clogged ears, manages recurrent otomycosis, keeps ear dry and inhibits graft rejections and elevations, also it may be advised for post-operative usage. It contains isopropyl alcohol and anhydrous glycerin as active ingredients.    

Isopropyl alcohol is an effective antiseptic and antibacterial agent. It evaporates and takes the excess moisture out of the ear, managing bacterial growth and promoting overall ear cleanliness. Anhydrous glycerin is used as a base, also it acts as a humectant which will manage the inner skin lining from turning complete dry.  

Always use Eardri Ear Drops as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. For usage, lay the individual on side with water-clogged ear up, then instil 4 to 5 drops of Eardri Ear Drops in each ear canal. Repeat the above process when water remains in the ear after swimming, bathing, showering or rainfall.
